title: Man Realizes His 9-Year-Old Niece Was Murdered
description:
A Florida woman is behind bars after allegedly playing a part in the death of her boyfriend’s 9-year-old child. Police took Tyshael Martin, 34, and Lojuan Sessions into custody after Lojuan’s daughter Jamaria Sessions, 9, was found unresponsive in the couple’s shared home. Detectives spent countless hours reviewing home security footage that allegedly revealed Tyshael's involvement. Get the details on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
